appDescription.message: Unofficial: real-time 3D for video and pictures in Chrome on Steam Frame. Needs the headset's framedepth-companion; data stays on the device.

detailHelp.message: Normal is best for video. High draws thin outlines a little sharper, but the headset runs hotter and 60 fps video can stutter. Highest is for pictures. On YouTube, 1080p is enough: higher only adds load.

help.message:
What turns 3D: the largest video in view; with no video, a large picture, or the pictures of a list or gallery.
Strength: how deep the 3D is, as the most each eye's picture is shifted (% of its width).
Pop-out: higher puts more in front of the screen, lower more behind (50 = half each way).
Soft edges: higher means less smearing and tearing at object edges, but softer 3D borders.
Sharpen: brings back detail the conversion softens (0 = off).
Depth detail: Normal for video. High has finer outlines but more load and heat. Highest uses the GPU and suits pictures (switching shows flat for a second or two).
Player controls and captions drawn over the video are found and kept on the screen plane.
Shortcuts: Alt+Shift+D turns 3D on or off, Alt+Shift+Up/Down changes the strength while 3D is on; keys for pop-out can be set in chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

companionError.message: Companion: error $ERROR$. Restart it (systemctl --user restart framedepth-companion); if it goes on, install again (Troubleshooting). Trying again in 10 s…

companionDisconnected.message: Companion: not connected. Check that it is installed and running (Troubleshooting).

companionBusy.message: Companion: in use by another Chrome profile. Turn 3D off there or close it, and this one takes over within 10 s.

companionIdle.message: Companion: waiting for a video or picture to turn 3D (a video at least 200×112, a picture about a fifth of the view, or several pictures)

statsVideo.message:
Video $VIDEO$ fps, $FRAMES$ fps drawn in 3D (read $GRAB$ ms, draw $WARP$ ms)
Depth maps $MAPS$/s, model $MODEL$ ms, $AGE$ ms behind the video

stats.message:
3D view $FPS$ fps (read $GRAB$ ms, draw $WARP$ ms)
Depth maps $MAPS$/s, model $MODEL$ ms, $AGE$ ms behind the video

versionMismatch.message: Versions differ: extension $EXT$, companion $COMP$. Reload FrameDepth in chrome://extensions; if they still differ, install again.

stereoSideBySide.message: 3D video (side by side): shown as it is

stereoTopBottom.message: 3D video (top and bottom): shown as it is

subtitles.message: Keep subtitles in the video flat

scrollflatHelp.message: While the page scrolls or the video moves, the flat video shows; the 3D comes back about 0.4 s after it stops. Off: the 3D follows a little late and can tear or flicker.

subtitlesHelp.message: Subtitles that are part of the picture are found and kept on the screen plane, so they do not blur or double.

presetHelpMovie.message: For films, dramas and concerts. Most of the picture sits behind the screen, so people cut by the frame edge do not come forward.

presetHelpAnime.message: For animation. Shallower depth and softer edges, so clean lines do not tear.

presetHelpGame.message: For game streams and videos. A little deeper and sharper than live action.

presetHelpPhoto.message: For pictures. The most depth, with Highest detail. Not for video: it can stutter.

presetChanged.message: Changed. "Save to this type" keeps these values; unsaved, the type goes back to its earlier values next time.

presetSaved.message: Uses your saved values ("Default" brings back the original ones).

viewNotInVr.message: No 3D yet: Chrome's window is not in SteamVR. Start Chrome inside the headset with SteamVR on. Trying again…

viewNoSteamVr.message: No 3D yet: cannot reach SteamVR. Check that it is running. Trying again…

viewRestarting.message: SteamVR or the display restarted: bringing the 3D back…

problemModelStopped.message: Problem: the depth model stopped, so the picture is flat. Set Depth detail to Normal, or restart the companion (systemctl --user restart framedepth-companion).

problemModelFails.message: Problem: the depth model keeps failing, so the depth may be stuck. Try Depth detail Normal.

problemNoModel.message: Problem: no depth model is running, so the picture is flat. Restart the companion (systemctl --user restart framedepth-companion).

problemGpu.message: Problem: the GPU could not draw the 3D. If it goes on, restart the companion (systemctl --user restart framedepth-companion).

detailRefused.message: Depth detail $NAME$ could not start: the model named above runs instead.

viewRestartVr.message: No 3D yet: SteamVR or the GPU did not take it ($ERROR$). Restart SteamVR; if that does not help, restart the companion too (systemctl --user restart framedepth-companion). Trying again…
